name: Starz Entertainment Corp.
summary: Starz Entertainment Corp. offers its premium, subscription-based video content to viewers throughout the United States and Canada. The company primarily focuses on delivering its STARZ-branded services, which are accessible directly to consumers via its dedicated application on various over-the-top (OTT) streaming platforms. Furthermore, it collaborates with multichannel video programming distributors (MVPDs) to extend its reach to subscribers. The company's operations are headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
